WHAT TO DO

1. Open the review: https://console.afiax.africa/console/reviews/AR-0001
2. For each person, choose Keep if they still need their access, or Remove to switch it off.
3. You're done when everyone has a decision. It takes about a minute per person.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Nobody's access changes until you decide: nothing is removed automatically. You'll get this reminder every week until the review is finished, and overdue reviews are reported to Oortcloud Ops.

NOT SURE ABOUT SOMEONE?
